answer: A concrete rule the ledger can enforce: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because signal only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, jetty is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any zephyr approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
